title: Scholarship or Scam?
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Practice spotting scholarship scams by deciding whether twelve realistic offers look legitimate or like a scam, and naming the sign that decides it.

learningObjectives: Students will detect warning signs in scholarship offers and classify each offer as likely legitimate or likely a scam, naming the sign that decided it.

keyQuestions: Why is any fee a warning sign, even a small one?
Why should you never pay to file the FAFSA?
What can you do to check an unfamiliar sponsor?
commonMisconceptions: Legitimate scholarships sometimes charge a small processing fee.
A professional-looking website means a sponsor is real.
assessmentOpportunities: Students correctly classify at least ten of the eleven clear-cut offers and name the deciding warning sign for each scam.
